description: Complete offline-first architecture specification. Covers storage, sync queue, idempotency, retry policy, conflict resolution, and user-facing sync status.
designPrinciples: Offline-first: app must function fully without connectivity
Partial truth now beats perfect truth never
No silent failures: user always knows sync state
Idempotent writes: safe to retry any operation
localStorage prohibited for queues and blobs (IndexedDB only)
Manual sync always available as fallback

primaryStorage.library: Native IndexedDB API (or Dexie.js wrapper if available in Base44)
usage: Cached entity data for offline viewing

evidenceBlobs.description: Binary file data for evidence pending upload

cachedEntities.description: Local cache of server entities for offline viewing

localStorage.reason: 5MB limit, synchronous API, no structured data support. Not suitable for queue or blob storage.
localStorage.allowedUseOnly: User preferences (theme, last selected site) — NOT operational data

serviceWorker.purpose: Cache static assets (HTML, CSS, JS) for fully offline app loading

syncEngine.description: Manages the offline queue, processes pending actions, handles retries and conflicts.

enqueue.description: Add a new action to the offline queue
steps: 4. If evidence upload: store blob in evidenceBlobs store

dequeue.description: Process next pending action from queue
steps: 1. Query syncQueue for oldest record with status='pending'
3. Send to server via appropriate backend function
4. If success: set status='completed', set processedAt
5. If failure: increment retryCount, set lastError, set status='failed' if retryCount >= 3

appOpen.description: App opens or returns to foreground
appOpen.behavior: Check connectivity, process pending if online

reconnect.behavior: Process pending after short delay (2 seconds)

afterQueueWrite.rationale: Allows batching of rapid sequential operations

processingOrder.rule: FIFO (First In, First Out) by createdAt timestamp
exceptions: Evidence uploads process in parallel (up to 2 concurrent)
Data operations process sequentially (order matters for dependencies)

batchProcessing.description: Process up to 10 actions per sync cycle
batchProcessing.rationale: Prevent overwhelming slow connections; maintain responsive UI

afterMaxRetries.userNotification: Show failed item with retry button

idempotencyOnRetry.behavior: If syncActionId already processed → return success without re-executing
guarantees: Same daily report submission sent 3x = creates only 1 report
Same evidence upload sent 3x = stores only 1 file
Same snag creation sent 3x = creates only 1 snag

idempotencyDesign.description: Every state-changing operation from the client includes a client-generated syncActionId (UUID v4). The server tracks processed syncActionIds to prevent duplicate execution.

clientSide.generation: UUID v4 generated on the client when action is created
clientSide.storage: Stored in IndexedDB syncQueue with the action
clientSide.transmission: Included in every API request as part of the payload

checkFlow: 2. Query SyncAction table: SELECT WHERE syncActionId = ?
3. If found AND status='completed' → return previous result (skip execution)
4. If found AND status='in_progress' → return 409 Conflict (concurrent duplicate)
5. If not found → create SyncAction record with status='in_progress'
serverSide.transactionWrapping: Steps 5-7 must be atomic (database transaction or equivalent)

conflictResolution.strategy: Last-write-wins for mutable fields; reject for immutable fields

immutableConflicts.scenario: Client attempts to modify immutable field
immutableConflicts.resolution: Server rejects with HTTP 409, client discards conflicting action
immutableConflicts.example: Client tries to edit submitted DailyReport → rejected

mutableConflicts.scenario: Two users update same mutable field (e.g., snag owner)
mutableConflicts.resolution: Last write wins (server timestamp determines winner)
mutableConflicts.example: PM A reassigns snag, PM B reassigns same snag → PM B's write wins if later

createConflicts.example: Foreman submits report offline, retries on reconnect → single report created

pendingCount.location: Below status indicator or in sync panel

failedItems.errorDisplay: Human-readable error message per failed item

healthCheck.description: Periodic lightweight ping to verify actual connectivity (navigator.onLine can be unreliable)
healthCheck.endpoint: Simple health check endpoint on server
healthCheck.fallback: If health check fails despite navigator.onLine=true, treat as offline

evidenceUploadHandling.description: Evidence uploads (photos, files) follow a separate queue path due to larger payload sizes.
flow: 3. Store blob in IndexedDB evidenceBlobs store
4. Create sync queue entry with actionType='uploadEvidence'
5. On sync: upload blob via base44.integrations.Core.UploadFile
6. On upload success: create Evidence entity with returned fileUrl

clientSideProcessing.compression: Compress to JPEG quality 80-85% if original exceeds 2MB
clientSideProcessing.minimumResolution: Preserve at least 800px on shortest dimension
clientSideProcessing.hashGeneration: SHA-256 hash of file content before upload
clientSideProcessing.exifPreservation: Extract and store EXIF data before any compression

uploadRetry.rationale: Larger payloads need longer backoff to avoid network congestion

localCacheStrategy.description: Local cache is a read-through cache, not source of truth
rules: Server is always source of truth
Local cache used for offline viewing only
Stale cache clearly indicated in UI (last synced timestamp)

optimisticUI.description: Show locally created items immediately in the UI
optimisticUI.behavior: Items created offline appear immediately with 'pending sync' indicator
optimisticUI.rollback: If server rejects item, mark as failed and show error to user
